record.body: Signature archiving is a designed standard for preserving Signature recordings: uncompressed originals, stable identifiers, full metadata including date, time, location, equipment, and settings, and a calibration tone reference for every recorder. The standard is modeled on real FAIR archiving principles, findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable, but it governs a fictional dataset, and the pair never claims any real archive holds these files. Standards apply to all three Signature layers, because a future reader of the fictional archive needs to know which layer each designed sound belongs to.
